howItWorks.title: A simple path from learning to better results
howItWorks.description: MedborgaTest helps you read the material, practice step by step and receive clear feedback.

one.title: Choose a subject
one.description: Choose one of the 13 subjects and read the related study material.

two.title: Answer questions
two.description: Practice with clear multiple-choice questions that resemble the format of the citizenship test.

three.title: Get instant feedback
three.description: See whether your answer is correct or incorrect and read a simple explanation immediately.

four.title: Learn in your language
four.description: Display translations in English, Arabic or Dari while the Swedish text always remains visible.

feedback.title: Instant feedback

subjects.title: Learn by subject

faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Here you can find answers to some of the most common questions about MedborgaTest.

whatIs.question: What is MedborgaTest?
whatIs.answer: MedborgaTest is a learning platform where you can read study material and prepare for the Swedish citizenship test using questions, explanations and translations.

languages.question: Which languages are available?
languages.answer: Swedish is the original language. Questions and explanations can also be displayed with support in English, Arabic and Dari.

subjects.question: Can I study and practice by subject?
subjects.answer: Yes. You can choose from 13 subjects, read the study material and then practice questions from the same subject.

feedback.question: Will I learn why an answer is correct or incorrect?
feedback.answer: Yes. After answering, you receive immediate feedback and a clear explanation.

simulator.question: Will there be a test simulator?
simulator.answer: Yes. A test simulator with a timer, results and statistics will be added in a later phase of the platform.

cta.title: Ready to prepare for the citizenship test?
cta.description: Read the study material, choose a subject, answer questions and receive clear explanations and translations immediately.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.paragraph1: MedborgaTest is an independent study service designed to help users prepare for the Swedish citizenship test.
disclaimer.paragraph2: We are not affiliated with, approved by, endorsed by or associated with the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR), the Swedish Migration Agency, the Swedish National Agency for Education or any other Swedish authority.
disclaimer.paragraph3: All practice questions, explanations and translations are developed independently for educational purposes and are based on publicly available study materials, including Sweden in Focus, together with other public information.
disclaimer.paragraph4: The questions are not the official examination questions, and MedborgaTest does not guarantee a passing result on the official citizenship test. Always check the latest information from UHR and the Swedish Migration Agency.

footer.description: Prepare for the citizenship test with study material, Swedish questions, clear explanations and support in several languages.
